pages.heading: Contact

sections.heading: Email
paragraphs: Write to us about specs, prices or sources. We can't sign off on wiring, structure or building code. Please ask a local professional for that.

pages.title: How we compare saunas
pages.description: Where our sauna specs come from, what we do when a value is missing, and what we don't do.
pages.heading: How we compare saunas
introduction: We collect specs, put them side by side and let you filter them. We don't test saunas and we don't sell them.

sections.heading: Where the specs come from
paragraphs: Product pages, manuals and spec sheets from the manufacturers. Shops can tell us a price, but we don't use them for technical specs. Every product page links its sources.

sections.heading: Every size counts separately
paragraphs: A two-person and a four-person version of the same sauna often need different circuits, so we never copy a value from one to the other. If sources disagree or a value is missing, we say so.

sections.heading: What the finder can and can't do
paragraphs: It narrows the list. It can't tell you whether a sauna is allowed or safe in your home. Clearances, door swing, wiring and local code are up to the manual and your contractor.

sections.heading: Corrections
paragraphs: If something is out of date, write to info@selectyoursauna.com with the page and the correct source. We'll check and fix it.

pages.title: Affiliate disclosure
pages.description: Which links earn us a commission, how they are marked, and why they don't change the order of saunas.
pages.heading: Affiliate links
introduction: Some shop links on this site are affiliate links through Awin. If you buy after clicking one, SeitenHafen361 may get a commission. You pay the same price.

sections.heading: How to spot them
paragraphs: They say "Affiliate link" right under the button. Clicking one takes you through Awin to the shop. Nothing loads in the background before you click.

sections.heading: They don't change the order
paragraphs: Which saunas we list, how they're sorted and what the finder shows has nothing to do with commission. Nobody pays to be ranked.

sections.heading: Prices
paragraphs: We check offers for the exact model. The price and terms on the shop's page are the ones that count.

pages.title: Privacy information for Select Your Sauna
pages.description: The current website data flows, hosting services and external-link boundaries for the US section.
pages.heading: What the website does with information
introduction: This notice describes the technical behavior of the public US section. Account settings, contract terms and jurisdiction-specific obligations are reviewed separately.

sections.heading: Operator and contact
paragraphs: Select Your Sauna is operated by SeitenHafen361, Schayan Yousefian, Freienwalder Str. 34, 13359 Berlin, Germany. Questions about this notice or a correction request can be sent to info@selectyoursauna.com.

sections.heading: Static delivery through Cloudflare
paragraphs: The site is exported as static HTML, CSS, images and JavaScript and delivered through Cloudflare. A request may include an IP address, time, host, path, query string, referrer, browser or system information and transfer metadata. Cloudflare Web Analytics is enabled for the domain and can receive performance and visit measurements through Cloudflare's analytics service. The exact account products, retention settings and applicable transfer terms are controlled in the Cloudflare account.

sections.heading: Finder and catalog choices
paragraphs: Finder and catalog choices are processed in the browser. They are reflected in the visible URL so that a result can be refreshed or shared. The site does not send those choices to its own database, create an account or build a profile. A later request for a shared or reloaded URL can include its query parameters in hosting request handling.

sections.heading: Analytics, cookies and external links
paragraphs: The checked-in public client contains no first-party advertising pixel or marketing cookie. External merchant pages open only after a visitor follows a link. A link marked Affiliate link passes through Awin, which can process attribution and request metadata under its own privacy and retention rules.

sections.heading: Email contact
paragraphs: The site uses a mailto link rather than a website form. Any message, sender address, attachments and transmission metadata are handled by the email systems chosen by the sender and recipient. The actual mailbox routing and retention configuration must be documented by the operator.

sections.heading: Review when services change
paragraphs: This page must be updated when analytics, a consent tool, a contact form, accounts, personalization, server-side redirects, new embeds or a new hosting or affiliate service is introduced. Applicable rights, contact procedures, retention periods and transfer information also need renewed review when the service or intended audience changes.
